analysis.title: Beta Technologies (BETA): 3Q26 First Take: Strong quarter
key_insights: BETA 3Q26 revenue, adjusted EBITDA and EPS were all above FactSet consensus. Revenue was $17.7mn against a GS estimate of $12.3mn, a 43.7% variance.
Backlog rose about $100mn sequentially to $4.0bn. Charging sites and nautical miles flown also increased sequentially.
BETA launched on 6 of the 7 selections in the FAA eIPP during the quarter. The A250 received a FAA Special Airworthiness Certificate to conduct demonstration flights with customers.
BETA raised FY26 revenue guidance to $52-57mn from $42-50mn, against consensus of $46.9mn. Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $(400)-(445)mn and Capex guidance of $150-200mn were reiterated.
GS is watching the earnings call for color on production ramp cadence and H500A motor certification.
GS rates BETA Buy with a 12-month price target of $28 (37.4% upside from $20.38), based on a 1.7X CY30E EV/Sales multiple. The target was cut from $29 on 13-Jul-26 and from $47 on 1-Dec-25.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue, adjusted EBITDA and EPS beat consensus, FY26 revenue guidance was raised, and backlog reached $4.0bn. The target rests on 1.7X CY30E EV/Sales.

earnings_insights: BETA 3Q26 revenue reported $17.7mn vs GS estimate $12.3mn and above consensus (reported 3Nov26).
BETA 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA reported $(97.4)mn vs GS estimate $(119.3)mn and FactSet consensus $(117.4)mn.
BETA 3Q26 diluted EPS reported $(0.51) vs GS estimate $(0.60), above FactSet consensus. 3Q25 diluted EPS was $(9.83).
BETA 3Q26 operating profit reported $(127.8)mn vs GS estimate $(149.0)mn. Net income was $(119.1)mn vs GS estimate $(138.0)mn.
BETA FY26 guidance: revenue $52-57mn (raised from $42-50mn, consensus $46.9mn), adjusted EBITDA $(400)-(445)mn (reiterated, consensus $(430)mn), Capex $150-200mn (reiterated, consensus $175.2mn).
GS estimates: FY26E revenue $50.1mn, FY27E $320.2mn, FY28E $905.8mn. FY26E EPS $(2.31), FY27E $(2.36), FY28E $(2.07). 4Q26E EPS $(0.54) and 1Q27E EPS $(0.57), both GS estimates.
